title: 带完整性验证的恢复代际
summary: 自动恢复不能只写一个 latest 文件；应校验格式、大小、checksum 和语义身份，保留上一代已知良好副本，并在落盘后重新读取验证精确字节。
invariants: Recovery packages have an explicit format/schema version and bounded total size.
Each embedded payload carries size and cryptographic checksum evidence.
Unsafe relative paths and malformed payloads are rejected before import.
A valid previous generation is retained before replacing latest.
The exact on-disk bytes are reread and validated before reporting backup success.
A failed backup attempt preserves prior healthy backup metadata rather than erasing evidence.
Import merges only compatible identities/routes and preserves conflicting packages for manual recovery.
